info.title: Roads API
info.description: Fetch Google roads using a viewport, road ID, or latitude/longitude coordinates.

get.description: This method takes a sequence of latitude,longitude points and snaps them to the most likely road segments. Optionally returns additional points giving the full road geometry. Also returns a place ID for each snapped point.

parameters.name: travelMode
parameters.description: The type of travel being tracked. This will constrain the paths we snap to.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: The asset ID of the asset to which this path relates. This is used for abuse detection purposes for clients with asset-based SKUs.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to be snapped as a series of lat, lng points. Specified as a string of the format: lat,lng|lat,lng|...

parameters.name: interpolate
parameters.description: Whether to interpolate the points to return full road geometry.

get.description: This method takes a sequence of place IDs and a list of types of speeds and returns those speeds for each road segment. If a speed is not known for a given place ID, that speed is not returned. If no speeds are known for a road segment, nothing is returned for that road segment.

parameters.name: placeId
parameters.description: The list of place IDs to return speeds for.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to first snap and retrieve speed limits for.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: The units that speeds should be returned in. Default is KPH.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The types of speeds to return.

parameters.name: locationEncoding
parameters.description: Encoding method to use for the response.

get.description: This method takes a sequence of place IDs and returns the speed limit for each road segment. If no speed limit is known for a given place ID, nothing is returned.

parameters.name: placeId
parameters.description: The list of place IDs to return speed limits for.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to first snap and retrieve speed limits for.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: The units that speed limits should be returned in. Default is KPH.

get.description: This method takes a list of latitude,longitude points and snaps them each to their nearest road. Also returns a place ID for each snapped point.

parameters.name: travelMode
parameters.description: The type of travel being tracked. This will constrain the roads we snap to.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: The points to be snapped as a series of lat, lng points. Specified as a string of the format: lat,lng|lat,lng|...

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Zoom level of the tile coordinate. The coordinate system is n*n tiles in size, where n = 2^zoom. Currently, only zoom level 8 is supported in this service.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: x-value of the tile coordinate. Ranges from 0 to 2^zoom

parameters.name: locationEncoding
parameters.description: Encoding method to use for the response.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: The units that speeds should be returned in. Default is KPH.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: y-value of the tile coordinate. Ranges from 0 to 2^zoom

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The types of speeds to return.

SnappedPoint.description: A snapped point object, representing the result of snapping.

placeId.description: The place ID for this snapped location (road segment). These are the same as are currently used by the Places API.

originalIndex.description: The index into the original path of the equivalent pre-snapped point. This allows for identification of points which have been interpolated if this index is missing.

ListSpeedLimitsResponse.description: The response from the ListSpeedLimits method, returning a list of speed limits.

warningMessage.description: User-visible warning message, if any, which can be shown alongside a valid result.

speedLimits.description: A list of speed limits for each point.

snappedPoints.description: A list of snapped points (if a path was snapped as part of the process).

SnapToRoadsResponse.description: The response from the SnapToRoads method, returning a sequence of snapped points.

warningMessage.description: User-visible warning message, if any, which can be shown alongside a valid result.

ListTrafficSpeedsForTileResponse.description: The response from the ListTrafficSpeedsForTile method, returning a list of traffic speeds for segments contained in the requested tile. The results are returned as a set of repeated fields, where the indices into each field line up. Only one of place_id and openlr can contain values. Only one of current_speed and freeflow_speed can contain values.

currentSpeeds.description: The current speed of each road segment.

openlrIds.description: The OpenLR location string for each road segment. Refer to LocationEncoding.OPENLR for details.

placeIds.description: The place ID of each road segment.

freeflowSpeeds.description: The speed without traffic of each road segment.

ListTrafficSpeedsResponse.description: The response from the ListTrafficSpeeds method, returning a list of traffic speeds.

trafficSpeeds.description: A list of traffic speeds for each point.

snappedPoints.description: A list of snapped points (if a path was snapped as part of the process).

warningMessage.description: User-visible warning message, if any, which can be shown alongside a valid result.

speedLimit.description: The speed limit of this road segment.

units.description: The units of the speed limit.

placeId.description: The place ID of this road segment.

LatLng.description: An object that represents a latitude/longitude pair. This is expressed as a pair of doubles to represent degrees latitude and degrees longitude. Unless specified otherwise, this object must conform to the WGS84 standard. Values must be within normalized ranges.

longitude.description: The longitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-180.0, +180.0].

latitude.description: The latitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-90.0, +90.0].

TrafficSpeeds.description: A set of speeds for a given road.

units.description: The units of the speeds returned.

currentSpeed.description: The current speed of this road segment.

openlrId.description: The OpenLR location string for the road segment. Refer to LocationEncoding.OPENLR for details.

placeId.description: The place ID of this road segment.

freeflowSpeed.description: The speed without traffic of this road segment.

ListNearestRoadsResponse.description: The response from the ListNearestRoads method, returning a list of snapped points.
